sources_considered.why: Read with find to verify the calculation's assumptions. Used only as context for an independent arithmetic check, not as evidence that actual spending matched the estimate.
Read in full. Reports annual R&D expenses, which are relevant context but do not supply matching second-half training cash expenditure.

evidence_items.locator: Training-cost paragraph following the first-half inference calculation

receipt.public_excerpt: For $2.5bn of revenue, OpenAI spent $6.7bn in training costs — or around $2.68 per dollar of revenue. At that rate, OpenAI spent a further $23.58bn on training, bringing us to $28.6bn in burn just for the back half of 2025.

evidence_items.explanation: The literal $2.68 rate produces the stated training estimate. Using the $4.3 billion revenue denominator in the preceding setup produces a materially smaller estimate; this item documents the ambiguity, not actual expenditure.

metric_scope.metric: conditional training spending and combined training-plus-inference spending

inputs: First-half revenue in the setup: $4.3 billion.
derived.formula: Literal training calculation: 8.8 × (6.7 / 2.5) = 23.584. With the stated rounded inference estimate: 23.584 + 5.1 = 28.684. Using the setup's common revenue denominator: training = 8.8 × (6.7 / 4.3) = 13.7116279; inference = 8.8 × (2.5 / 4.3) = 5.1162791; combined spending = 18.8279070.
derived.rounding: All amounts are USD billions. The literal training result rounds to 23.58; combined spending rounds to 28.7 to one decimal. Using the common $4.3 billion denominator gives 13.71, 5.12, and 18.83.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph introducing annual research and development expenses

receipt.public_excerpt: But the company’s fast-growing revenues are still dwarfed by its even more significant expenses.

evidence_items.explanation: The article reports $19.18 billion of R&D expense for all of 2025 from audited statements. Annual R&D expense is neither second-half training cash spending nor the result of the specified hypothetical ratios.

unresolved_gaps: The text supplies incompatible first-half revenue denominators.
No matching second-half training and inference cash-spending records were obtained.
The available annual R&D figure cannot be substituted for the claimed period and cost category.
